profile_text.body:
Google is a for-profit public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, traded on public markets under the ticker GOOGL. Its own website, hosted at gemini.google.com, presents the company primarily through its AI assistant Gemini, describing it as a tool for writing, planning, brainstorming, and generative AI tasks more broadly.

The company's tracked AI product portfolio spans several categories. Gemini serves as its general large language model assistant, while Google AI Studio is positioned for model prototyping by developers. Google Med-PaLM and MedLM are medical large language models aimed at clinical reasoning and healthcare data applications, noted as requiring a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement. Workspace-integrated products include Google Drive AI, Google Meet AI for meeting summaries and live captions, and NotebookLM, which grounds responses in user-uploaded documents. TensorFlow and Keras are tracked as Google's open-source machine learning frameworks, with TensorFlow Extended covering MLOps workflows.

The held facts show Google filing a 10-K for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, reporting revenue of $402,836,000,000. The site records 174 legal matters associated with California jurisdiction. Google's services also appear as integration targets across ten third-party MCP servers, covering Google Ads campaign management, Google Calendar scheduling, Google Forms, Google Search Console, and Google Trends data, built by various external developers against Google's platforms.
